descriptionChirho: Verb meaning to show, exhibit, or demonstrate something visually or evidentially, used across different inflectional forms (infinitive, participle, imperative) with the same core meaning of making something visible or evident. Multilingual evidence: eng 'to show/showing/show', spa 'mostrar/mostrando/demostrando/mostraos' (to show/showing/demonstrating/show yourselves), hin 'dikhaane/dikhaate hue/dikhaao' (to show/while showing/show!), arb 'li-yuruhu/muzhiraat/azhiru' (to show him/displaying/show!), kor 'boigi-reul/boyeojumyeo/boyeora' (showing/while showing/show!), swa 'kuwaonyesha/wakionyesha/jionyesheni' (to show them/while showing/show yourselves). Used of Jesus showing his works (Acts 18:28, demonstrating from Scripture) and moral instruction (Titus 2:10, showing all good fidelity).
